title: G — PURE RETIREMENT IMAGE PLANNER
acceptance: G — PURE RETIREMENT IMAGE PLANNER, cap +550. Depends on A/C and the captured representations in E. Produce a non-runnable quarantine/retirement image for every inventoried metadata/session/delegation/runtime authority category, retaining original arguments, prompts/history, source facts, receipts and unresolved reasons. Unknown potentially affected data refuses the plan. No live caller, persistence or producer operation in the planner. Acceptance subset: I5 category-by-category positive/negative controls and preserved content; I4 isolation of unaffected stores; I7 dormant reachability. If the actual category handling cannot fit, split session/queue retirement and metadata/delegation/evidence retirement into separate pure planners; neither partial plan may be treated as a complete transaction manifest.
